howToPlay: Use the Super to close the gap or escape, taking advantage of the damage reduction and wall bounces. Deploy the gadgets to slow enemies or replenish the Super, and combine this with the Star Powers to either tank incoming fire or burst down targets with faster reloads.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and SPEED to capitalize on close-range encounters. HEALTH and SHIELD are also effective for maintaining longevity as a tank.
trait: Darryl is ideal for players who prefer aggressive, high-mobility combat and calculated surprise attacks.
